meta.name: Employee Pay Rates — dated rates screen
meta.description: Payroll phase 1b: the rates panel in an employee's finance tab. Creates an instructor with a service capability through the API (the DB trigger seeds its first rate), then in the UI schedules a future rate, checks the warnings for a back-dated rate and for a date that already has a rate, adds a rate for another service through the add-rate dialog, and adds an hourly rate — which switches the employee's pay model so the rate is actually read. Rates are never edited in place (PAY-A1, PAY-A2). A missing rate blocks adding a lesson (422 instructor_rate_not_configured) but never blocks marking attendance.
meta.author: claude-ai

steps.description: Sign in with admin credentials

workflows.name: API – Service and instructor with a rate
workflows.description: Creates the fixture instructor and a service capability, then sets that service's rate through the rates endpoint. A capability no longer carries money, so the rate has to be created on its own.

steps.description: Fetch the first available service
Store the service name for UI selectors
Store a second service name, the one added through the rate picker
Create the fixture instructor
Assign the service to the instructor (capacity and availability only — no rate)
The instructor's rate for that service, in effect from the start of employment
The API returns the seeded rate for the instructor

workflows.name: UI – Schedule a future rate
workflows.description: Opens the instructor's finance tab and saves a rate that starts in the future; it must show as scheduled while the current rate stays.

steps.description: Select the fixture instructor in the roster
Switch to the finance tab
The rates panel is shown
The seeded rate of the service is shown, labelled as the current rate
Open the update form of the service card
The new rate is listed as scheduled from 01.01.2027
The card now offers the rate history

workflows.name: UI – Back-dated rate warns before saving
workflows.description: A rate dated in the past warns that it affects days that already happened, before anything is saved.

steps.description: The warning about days that already happened is shown
Pick the date of the rate scheduled in the previous workflow
Choosing a date that already has a rate warns that saving replaces it
Leave without saving

workflows.name: UI – Add a rate for another service through the dialog
workflows.description: A rate always belongs to a service, so the panel opens a dialog that picks the service and sets the rate. The new card says the service is not assigned to the employee yet.

steps.description: Open the add-rate dialog from the panel header
The kind the employee is actually paid by is preselected and marked as in use
Open the service list inside the dialog
Pick the second service
Back-date it, so the dialog shows the same warnings the card does
The service now has a card of its own, tagged as a service the employee is not assigned to
The API returns a rate for that service
A service the employee is not assigned to offers to set it up from the card

workflows.name: A capability edit no longer rewrites the rate
workflows.description: A per-session rate set in the rates screen used to be replaced by an hourly one whenever anything else on the capability was saved: the capability carried an hourly rate, and a trigger copied it into RateHistory as lesson_hourly. The capability endpoint no longer carries money at all.

steps.description: The office agrees ₪200 per session in the rates screen
Later someone edits only the capacity and availability of that service
Leave the tab so the panel unmounts
Re-enter it, which refetches the rates
The per-session rate is still the current one — nothing converted it

workflows.name: Replacing a rate on the same date changes its kind too
workflows.description: Only one lesson rate applies on a date, so saving a per-session rate over an hourly one must change the kind as well as the amount. Updating the amount alone would leave the row hourly and multiply it by the lesson length.

steps.description: An hourly rate on a chosen date
The same date is refused unless the office confirms the replacement
Confirmed: the same date becomes a per-session rate
The replaced row is a per-session rate, not an hourly one
The hourly amount it replaced is gone
Opening the update form on a per-session rate keeps למפגש selected, so a raise does not change the agreement
The unit toggle opens on למפגש — the unit already in effect

workflows.name: Capacity and working hours are edited on the service card
workflows.description: Everything about one service in one place: the rate, how many riders, and when the instructor works. Saving the scheduling part must not touch the rate.

steps.description: Open the scheduling part of the service card
The card shows the new capacity and the day
The per-session rate is exactly as it was
With a rate and working hours the card says the instructor can be scheduled
How the service pays is stated next to the amount

workflows.name: UI – An hourly rate is added on top of the lesson rates
workflows.description: An instructor who also does stable or office work is paid for both: adding an hourly rate adds a part of the pay, it does not replace the lesson pay (PAY-A6).

steps.description: Choose the hourly kind
The hourly rate is listed under the work-pay group
The lesson rate is still there and still paid — nothing was replaced
No rate is marked as unused: every kind the employee has is paid
A lower hourly rate is back-dated to 2025 — it must not become the current rate
Today's hourly rate is still ₪55 — the back-dated ₪40 applies only to its own period

workflows.name: UI – A fixed leave-day value is set with the leave pay in the finance tab
workflows.description: The fixed value of a paid leave day is a dated leave_day rate, set in the finance tab's leave-pay box and saved through api/employee-rates. There is no leave-day column on the employee any more.

steps.description: The employee's leave is paid by a fixed day value
No leave-day value has been set yet
The value is shown per day in the leave-pay box
Leave pay is not one of the rates for work: no rate card for it

workflows.name: Attendance keeps only other work; lesson minutes are read from the calendar
workflows.description: Pay is computed live from facts. An attendance day stores only the minutes of work that is not a lesson; the endpoint returns the lesson minutes of each day next to the records, read from the calendar, and nothing is copied onto the row.

steps.description: The office enters 45 minutes of other work on the first day of this month
The month's read returns the lesson-days list (empty for an instructor with no lessons)
Select the fixture instructor in the roster
The day shows the other work that was entered, and no lesson minutes
No day shows lesson minutes: this instructor has no lessons this month

workflows.name: A missing rate blocks adding a lesson, never marking attendance
workflows.description: A person who adds a lesson must pick an instructor who is paid for that service on that date: without a rate the save is refused with a stable code and the fields the form needs to offer adding the rate. Marking what happened in a lesson always works, even when the rate is missing: the monthly review shows the lesson as missing a rate instead.

steps.description: An instructor with no rate at all
A rider for the lesson
Adding a lesson for the instructor is refused with 422 and code instructor_rate_not_configured
Puts the refusal code in the address (before the hash, which the app never rewrites) so it can be asserted; a lesson created instead would leave no code there
The office adds the rate the refusal asked for
The same lesson saves once the rate exists
Move the rate to start after the lesson (direct Supabase PATCH), so the lesson has no rate on its date
Marking the rider attended still works: attendance is never blocked by a missing rate (any error status fails the run)
Changing the mark to a no-show also works, with the pay decision from the absence form

workflows.name: UI – The lesson form offers to add a missing rate and keeps what was typed
workflows.description: In the calendar's add-lesson form, an instructor without a rate for the service on the date is refused by the server. The form stays open with the missing-rate notice; 'הוספת תעריף' opens the rate dialog prefilled with that service and date; after the rate is saved the form still holds everything typed, and saving again creates the lesson.

steps.description: An instructor who can teach the service but has no rate
Capability for the service, available every day 06:00-22:00, so the form offers the instructor and 09:00
A rider to pick in the form
Open the add-lesson form
Search the rider in the participant picker
The lesson date: the first of this month
Save: the server refuses because the instructor has no rate
(1) The missing-rate notice with its button appears
(1) The lesson form stays open
Bring the notice and its button into view for the screenshot
(2) The rate dialog opens on the lesson's service
(2) ... and on the lesson's date

steps.selector: [role='dialog']:has-text('כל תעריף חל מהתאריך שנבחר') button:has-text('שמירת תעריף')

steps.description: (3) The form still holds the rider
(3) ... the service
(3) ... the instructor
(3) ... and the date
(4) Save again
(4) The lesson is created and the form closes
(4) Read the instructor's lessons (direct Supabase read)
Puts the found lesson id in the address so it can be asserted (no lesson stores '[]')
(4) Exactly the lesson the form saved exists
